response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS num_distinct_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind
